description: He wears a long plum-purple patterned coat with full sleeves, open over a cream textured tunic with a short split neckline and narrow gold-and-dark woven borders. Similar broad decorated edging follows the coat front, cuffs and hem. A brown leather belt with an ornate circular fitting and flat decorated hanging end shapes the waist. Brown trousers and tall worn brown leather boots complete the opaque layered outfit. Hands rest together near the belt. The clothing is finely made everyday Imperial noble attire with restrained ornament. No crown, headgear, armor or weapon appears; the purple fabric has a velvet-like finish but its actual composition is uncertain.
